No successful capacity-commitment or warm-throughput update was attempted: shared settings and paid warm provisioning were intentionally preserved. No account/stream TPS, concurrent-create quota or 100-stream page cap was stress-tested.

findings.finding: Stream identifiers are account/region scoped; mismatched name/ARN rejects rather than choosing ARN. StreamName does not accept an ARN. ARN endpoint-region mismatch rejects. A missing local name in another region is not found. Nonexistent account 999000999000 returned UnrecognizedClientException; this does not establish real cross-account policy behavior.

CreateStream is asynchronous; duplicate creation rejects. DescribeStream has shard pagination, while Summary has OpenShardCount and MaxRecordSizeInKiB; the exact optional fields are retained in native responses.

ListStreams supports exclusive-name and opaque-token continuation; token plus exclusive name rejects. Invalid token and zero limit reject. Limit 101 is admitted, but the documented effective page cap of 100 was not load-tested.

Old and new stream-tag APIs share a case-sensitive merge map, overwrite supplied keys without replacing other keys, preserve empty values, and remove absent keys successfully. Old list supports ExclusiveStartTagKey/Limit; new list returns Tags without HasMoreTags. Empty map and aws:-prefixed keys reject; rejected over-limit tag write preserves state.

Retention equal to current is an accepted no-op. Bounds are 24–8760 hours. Wrong-direction decrease rejects. A real retention change returns success, initially exposes UPDATING with the old value, then ACTIVE with the desired value.
Enhanced monitoring is asynchronous; write calls during its UPDATING phase reject ResourceInUseException. Response distinguishes CurrentShardLevelMetrics and DesiredShardLevelMetrics.
UpdateShardCount target equal to current succeeds with equal CurrentShardCount/TargetShardCount; zero rejects. Actual split/merge/resize lineage is delegated to records evidence.

MaxRecordSizeInKiB validation rejects 1023 and 10241 against documented 1024–10240 bounds; 1024 and 2048 updates were exercised. Updating is asynchronous and exposes the old size while UPDATING; conflicting/repeated updates in that state reject.

Account commitment is DISABLED. UpdateStreamWarmThroughput values 0 and 1 both fail account-commitment admission even on a provisioned stream. Malformed account status rejects before authorization; no valid account-setting mutation was sent.

On an existing stream, GetResourcePolicy without a policy returns the string "{}"; DeleteResourcePolicy absent returns ResourceNotFoundException. Put replaces the complete document; identical replacement succeeds. Invalid JSON rejects.

IAM stream controls use the stream ARN and exact action: DescribeStreamSummary does not grant DescribeStream/GetResourcePolicy; TagResource, AddTagsToStream and UntagResource permissions are distinct; policy Get/Put/Delete are distinct. An unauthorized missing stream denies before not-found. DescribeLimits needs Resource "*", not a stream ARN. Session policies and role base policies are retained.

Encryption with alias/aws/kinesis transitions NONE→UPDATING→KMS and stop transitions KMS→UPDATING→NONE. Repeating Start with the same key succeeds and still transitions through UPDATING; stopping an unencrypted stream rejects InvalidArgumentException.

Mode switches expose old mode during UPDATING and desired mode after ACTIVE. ON_DEMAND adds native RecordDistributionStrategy=USER_PARTITION_KEY (not in the pinned SDK summary struct). Repeating ON_DEMAND succeeds without consuming a switch; the third actual switch within this capture rejects LimitExceededException after two real switches.

CreateStream with Tags requires the distinct dependent kinesis:AddTagsToStream permission on the prospective stream ARN. CreateStream-only and CreateStream plus TagResource sessions both deny AddTagsToStream; adding AddTagsToStream succeeds.

Settled monitoring writes are set union/removal: adding an existing metric or disabling already-empty ALL is an accepted no-op and the first subsequent Summary remains ACTIVE. Changing mode to its existing PROVISIONED mode is likewise a no-op.
Settled UpdateMaxRecordSize with unchanged size succeeds and the first subsequent Summary remains ACTIVE; changing back to 1024 transitions through UPDATING and completes.

Exactly 50 tags is accepted; adding tag 51 rejects, replacing an existing key at the quota succeeds. ListTagsForStream and ListTagsForResource need distinct IAM actions. A session with only DeleteResourcePolicy reaches its absent-policy ResourceNotFound error but cannot GetResourcePolicy.

Deleting and recreating the same stream name/ARN with a new StreamCreationTimestamp did not reset the mode-change rejection observed in this capture. The followup ON_DEMAND change was rejected, leaving PROVISIONED; therefore the operation labelled max-record-on-demand actually exercised a provisioned stream and does NOT establish on-demand max-size admission.

Resource-policy storage visibility precedes authorization propagation. Deny on owner IAM-user DescribeStreamSummary was immediately readable while Summary still succeeded; a later read ~7 seconds after Put was explicitly denied by the resource policy. After deletion Get returned the empty policy immediately but Summary remained denied until a later sample. This is sampled eventual propagation, not a fixed latency guarantee. The earlier immediate role-Deny success is not evidence that Deny is ignored.
